instruction.name: vflogb.d
instruction.description: Compute base-2 logarithm of double precision floating point elements in `a`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Vector registers initialised with normal 1.0/2.0 values, not byte-replicated integers. Measured with unroll=100000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vflogb.d $vr0, $vr8; vflogb.d $vr1, $vr9; vflogb.d $vr2, $vr10; vflogb.d $vr3, $vr11; vflogb.d $vr4, $vr12; vflogb.d $vr5, $vr13; vflogb.d $vr6, $vr14; vflogb.d $vr7, $vr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vflogb.d $vr0, $vr8; vflogb.d $vr1, $vr9; vflogb.d $vr2, $vr10; vflogb.d $vr3, $vr11; vflogb.d $vr4, $vr12; vflogb.d $vr5, $vr13; vflogb.d $vr6, $vr14; vflogb.d $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. Sources are normal float values. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX vector floating-point instruction. Measured on LA664 with normal float operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
